candidate.name: carrier_conservation_record_program
candidate.unit: complete action -> checkpoint -> action microrecords, anchored first at f26r.2#4-8 and tested against f77v.7#3-5, f80v.35, and f88r.19
candidate.representation: Each record carries one latent carrier identity and a finite field transition. A state-only checkpoint may change state but cannot create a new carrier; a later action either reuses the carried carrier or has an explicit source-visible new-carrier head.
candidate.observable: Freeze source forms and positions, not German labels: identify action/checkpoint/action windows, exact whole-form heads, written-head recurrence, deictic/objectless markers, and the next written head. On held windows, test whether the conservation rule predicts recurrence versus a genuinely new head better than an independent-record/context renderer.
candidate.rival: Three independent local records plus a context-conditioned renderer can reproduce the same positional graph and arbitrary head assignments; GDT700's C011 gloss cannot be used as independent carrier truth.
candidate.falsifier: A held checkpoint window changes the predicted carrier relation without a source-visible new-head marker, or independent-record/context models match the recurrence pattern. Repeated heads in f80v.35/f88r.19 must remain controls because GDT704 says they need not be output continuations.
candidate.route_change_if_supported: Use the conserved carrier/field relation as a record scaffold: infer which forms are state/control versus payload, then translate payload values only after the scaffold transfers to held records. This yields representation leverage without treating the scaffold as German prose.
candidate.route_change_if_rejected: Keep GDT700/C015 as occurrence-bound relations and do not build a procedural decoder or promote the local German working glosses.

symmetry_and_minimal_break.symmetry: All current structural observations survive a permutation of latent carrier names. A stack, state, or host label can therefore be renamed while preserving every observed edge and renderer output.
symmetry_and_minimal_break.minimal_break: At least two held windows must share a source-visible carrier relation while differing in operation/state context, and the relation must predict a later written-head or field event that the independent-record rival cannot match. A repeated analyst gloss, page position, or GDT808 nuisance relation alone does not break the symmetry.
symmetry_and_minimal_break.assessment: The admitted anchors motivate the finite conservation question, but GDT700/704 already spent the available local evidence and found only one local edge; no independent held carrier endpoint is currently fixed. GDT808 supplies portable record/form axes but explicitly supplies no shared carrier meaning. Therefore this is a design concept, not an authorized rerun or decipherment result.
